name: Dirty Deeds (Combat, Technique)
body:
You’re not above hitting below the belt to win a fight.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, Combat Expertise, Improved Dirty Trick, base attack bonus +4

Benefit(s): Once per round, after making a successful dirty trick maneuver, you may make a melee attack against the same target at your full attack bonus.
